description: Mark a submission real (delivers it if it was held or dropped) or spam. A label that disagrees with Doorman becomes one of the few examples the form's next checks are judged with.

always.description: Also add a rule: always deliver (real) or always drop (spam) this sender or its domain. Domain is refused for free-mail providers.

api_key.description: Doorman API key (dm_live_...). Only needed if the MCP connection has no Authorization header.

name: doorman_label_submission
